To understand why the pod was missing, I checked for its controlling ReplicaSet, also named 'notification-relay'. The API server again returned 'NotFound' (ev_003).
The absence of both the pod and its ReplicaSet rules out transient pod issues (like a crash loop) and points to a missing higher-level controller, likely the Deployment.
The conclusion is that the entire application is not deployed, which is why no traffic is being received.
